name: Rope overhead triceps extension
definition: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the upper arms overhead and both hands holding the rope. Extend the elbows to move the hands upward, then lower the hands behind the head.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the upper arms overhead and both hands holding the rope.
value.movement: Extend the elbows to move the hands upward, then lower the hands behind the head.
value.finish: Return to the same overhead-arm flexed-elbow start.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable elbow travel with overhead upper-arm position; record cable line and stance.
